sections_target.text: This document sets out the test steps for the differential protection device mentioned above. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Badry Attia Raphael at the Assiut Steam Power Station; it was tested on 18 March 2003, and the document was approved by Eng. Hussein Ahmed El Mahdy, General Manager of the station.

items: Issue an approved order from the competent authority, and the test crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Isolate the circuit breaker of the equipment on which the device is to be tested and complete the isolation of this equipment
Review the device test certificate to know the required setting values
Test set, current injection unit SVERKER 650
AC current measuring instrument, clamp meter type KEW SNAP 2002

sections_target.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out

rows: Verify that the equipment is out of service
Connect the current cable to the protection device to be tested
Connect the AC current cable to the current injection unit used in the test
Connect the terminals from the test set to the protection device on phase R
Connect the B10 DC switch of the equipment whose differential protection is to be tested
Connect the current injection unit SEVRKER 650
Measure the injected AC current with the clamp meter type KEW SNAP 2002
Raise the current value until the signal appears
Reset the differential protection device on phase R
Repeat steps 4 to 9 on phases T, S
Test tripping the equipment circuit breaker by means of the DMS differential protection device

sections_target.text: Steps to Return the Equipment to Service

rows: Remove the current connection cable from the protection device
Check all connections to the protection device after the test
Remove all tools and instruments used in the test
Put the protection device in service in preparation for connecting the equipment

Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the differential protection device mentioned above. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Badry Attia Raphael at the Assiut Steam Power Station; it was tested on 18 March 2003, and the document was approved by Eng. Hussein Ahmed El Mahdy, General Manager of the station.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved order from the competent authority, and the test crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Isolate the circuit breaker of the equipment on which the device is to be tested and complete the isolation of this equipment
Review the device test certificate to know the required setting values
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Test set, current injection unit SVERKER 650
AC current measuring instrument, clamp meter type KEW SNAP 2002
Test leads used
Timer 0.0 - 0.3 sec
Work Steps to be Carried Out
Verify that the equipment is out of service | 1
Connect the current cable to the protection device to be tested | 2
Connect the AC current cable to the current injection unit used in the test | 3
Connect the terminals from the test set to the protection device on phase R | 4
Connect the B10 DC switch of the equipment whose differential protection is to be tested | 5
Connect the current injection unit SEVRKER 650 | 6
Measure the injected AC current with the clamp meter type KEW SNAP 2002 | 7
Raise the current value until the signal appears | 8
Reset the differential protection device on phase R | 9
Repeat steps 4 to 9 on phases T, S | 10
Test tripping the equipment circuit breaker by means of the DMS differential protection device | 11
Steps to Return the Equipment to Service
Remove the current connection cable from the protection device | 1
Check all connections to the protection device after the test | 2
Remove all tools and instruments used in the test | 3
Put the protection device in service in preparation for connecting the equipment | 4
